_note: Curated via CURATION_PROMPT.md (curate-classic-gear). Priest is a pure Intellect/Spirit CLOTH caster. Discipline + Holy are healers (engine weights Int 1.0 / Spirit 0.7 / Sta 0.5) and share ONE healer gear profile (Int/Spirit robes; Magister's/Dreamweave/Silver-thread lines, endgame Magister's set). Shadow is caster DPS (Int 1.0 / Spirit 0.6 / Sta 0.5) with its OWN Int/Stamina profile (Shadoweave/Kentic/Devout + Necropile line). Weapons (staves, 1H maces, daggers, wands, off-hands carrying Int/Spirit) are shared by all 3 specs. Every id verified MATCH (quality>=2, id<200000, real required level) and every armor piece stat-validated for a scored Int/Spirit/Stamina primary -- statless spell-power/healing/random-suffix pieces were dropped. No priest race/faction-locked items and no weapon-skill racial display effect, so all 5 races (Human/Dwarf/NightElf/Undead/Troll) get identical copies. Each band carries ~4-6 armor pieces and ~4 weapons per spec. Genuine Era gap: weapons band 1-10 is empty -- no uncommon+ Priest-usable caster weapon with a required level of 1-10 exists in Classic Era (that range is white/gray starter weapons only); armor band 1-10 uses the low starter greens (Ancestral/Journeyman/Adept's) since fixed-stat uncommon caster cloth is scarce that low. bis = level-60 raid epics (MC/BWL/ZG/AQ/Naxx): healer BiS for Disc+Holy, Shadow DPS BiS for Shadow, sourced separately from the leveling pool.
